| Secret key for connecting to Amazon CloudWatch |\\n| `sigV4AccessKey` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | SigV4 access key. Required when using keys auth provider |\\n| `sigV4SecretKey` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | SigV4 secret key. Required when using keys auth provider |\\n\\n> Note\\n>\\n> The _HTTP\\\\*_ tag denotes data sources that communicate using the HTTP protocol, including all core data source plugins except MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL.\\n\\n#### Custom HTTP headers for data sources\\n\\nYou can add HTTP headers to all requests sent to data sources managed by Grafana provisioning\\nConfigure the header name in the `jsonData` field and the header value in `secureJsonData`.\\nThe following example sets the `HeaderName` header to have the value `HeaderValue` and the `Authorization` header to have the value `Bearer XXXXXXXXX`:\\n\\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\\n\\n```yaml\\napiVersion: 1\\n\\ndatasources:\\n  - name: Graphite\\n    jsonData:\\n      httpHeaderName1: 'HeaderName'\\n      httpHeaderName2: 'Authorization'\\n    secureJsonData:\\n      httpHeaderValue1: 'HeaderValue'\\n      httpHeaderValue2: 'Bearer XXXXXXXXX'\\n```\\n\\n## Plugins\\n\\nYou can manage plugin applications in Grafana by adding one or more YAML configuration files in the [`provisioning/plugins`](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-grafana/#provisioning) directory.\\nEach configuration file contains a list of `apps` that Grafana configures during start up.\\nGrafana configures each app to use the configuration in the file.\\n\\n> Note\\n>\\n> This feature enables you to provision plugin configurations, not the plugins themselves.\\n> You must have already installed the plugin to use plugin configuration provisioning.\\n\\n### Example plugin configuration file\\n\\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\\n\\n```yaml\\napiVersion: 1\\n\\napps:\\n  # <string> the type of app, plugin identifier. Required\\n  - type: raintank-worldping-app\\n    # <int> Org ID. Default to 1, unless org_name is specified\\n    org_id: 1\\n    # <string> Org name. Overrides org_id unless org_id not specified\\n    org_name: Main Org.\\n    # <bool> disable the app. Default to false.\\n    disabled: false\\n    # <map> fields that will be converted to json and stored in jsonData. Custom per app.\\n    jsonData:\\n      # key/value pairs of string to object\\n      key: value\\n    # <map> fields that will be converted to json, encrypted and stored in secureJsonData. Custom per app.\\n    secureJsonData:\\n      # key/value pairs of string to string\\n      key: value\\n```\\n\\n## Dashboards\\n\\nYou can manage dashboards in Grafana by adding one or more YAML configuration files in the [`provisioning/dashboards`](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-grafana/#dashboards) directory.\\nEach configuration file contains a list of `providers` that Grafana uses to load dashboards from the local filesystem.\\n\\n### Example dashboard configuration file\\n\\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\\n\\n```yaml\\napiVersion: 1\\n\\nproviders:\\n  # <string> an unique provider name. Required\\n  - name: 'a unique provider name'\\n    # <int> Org id. Default to 1\\n    orgId: 1\\n    # <string> name of the dashboard folder.\\n    folder: ''\\n    # <string> folder UID. will be automatically generated if not specified\\n    folderUid: ''\\n    # <string> provider type. Default to 'file'\\n    type: file\\n    # <bool> disable dashboard deletion\\n    disableDeletion: false\\n    # <int> how often Grafana will scan for changed dashboards\\n    updateIntervalSeconds: 10\\n    # <bool> allow updating provisioned dashboards from the UI\\n    allowUiUpdates: false\\n    options:\\n      # <string, required> path to dashboard files on disk. Required when using the 'file' type\\n      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards\\n      # <bool> use folder names from filesystem to create folders in Grafana\\n      foldersFromFilesStructure: true\\n```\\n\\nWhen Grafana starts, it updates or creates all dashboards found in the configured path.\\nThese files can define the dashboard using the dashboard JSON:\\n\\nJSON![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\\n\\n```json\\n{\\n  \\\"dashboard\\\": {\\n    \\\"id\\\": null,\\n    \\\"uid\\\": \\\"example-dashboard\\\",\\n    \\\"title\\\": \\\"Production Overview\\\",\\n    \\\"tags\\\": [\\\"production\\\", \\\"monitoring\\\"],\\n    \\\"timezone\\\": \\\"browser\\\",\\n    \\\"schemaVersion\\\": 16,\\n    \\\"version\\\": 0,\\n    \\\"refresh\\\": \\\"30s\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"folderUid\\\": \\\"monitoring-folder\\\",\\n  \\\"overwrite\\\": true\\n}\\n```\\n\\nOr using a Kubernetes format, for example `kubernetes-dashboard.json`:\\n\\nJSON![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\\n\\n```json\\n{\\n  \\\"kind\\\": \\\"Dashboard\\\",\\n  \\\"apiVersion\\\": \\\"dashboard.grafana.app/v1\\\",\\n  \\\"metadata\\\": {\\n    \\\"name\\\": \\\"dashboard-uid\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"spec\\\": {\\n    \\\"title\\\": \\\"Dashboard title\\\",\\n    \\\"panels\\\": [\\\\\\n      {\\\\\\n        \\\"gridPos\\\": {\\\\\\n          \\\"h\\\": 13,\\\\\\n          \\\"w\\\": 24,\\\\\\n          \\\"x\\\": 0,\\\\\\n          \\\"y\\\": 0\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\n        \\\"options\\\": {\\\\\\n          \\\"content\\\": \\\"<div><h1>Example panel</h1></div>\\\",\\\\\\n          \\\"mode\\\": \\\"html\\\"\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\n        \\\"transparent\\\": true,\\\\\\n        \\\"type\\\": \\\"text\\\"\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\n    ]\\n  }\\n}\\n```\\n\\nYou _must_ use the Kubernetes resource format to provision dashboards v2 / dynamic dashboards.\\n\\n> Note\\n>\\n> Grafana installs dashboards at the root level if you don’t set the `folder` field.\\n\\n#### Detect updates to provisioned dashboards files\\n\\nAfter Grafana provisions your dashboards, it checks the filesystem for changes and updates dashboards as needed.\\n\\nThe mechanism Grafana uses to do this depends on your `updateIntervalSeconds` value:\\n\\n- **More than 10 seconds**: Grafana polls the path at that interval.\\n- **10 seconds or less**: Grafana watches the filesystem for changes and updates dashboards when it detects them.\\n\\n> Note\\n>\\n> When `updateIntervalSeconds` is 10 or less, Grafana relies on filesystem watch events to detect changes.\\n> Depending on your filesystem and how you mount or sync dashboard files (for example, Docker bind mounts or some network filesystems), those events might not reach Grafana.\\n> To work around this, set `updateIntervalSeconds` to more than 10 to force polling, or update your setup so filesystem watch events are propagated.\\n\\n#### Make changes to a provisioned dashboard\\n\\nYou can make changes to a provisioned dashboard in the Grafana UI but its not possible to automatically save the changes back to the provisioning source.\\nIf `allowUiUpdates` is set to `true` and you make changes to a provisioned dashboard, when you save the dashboard, Grafana persists the changes to its database.\\n\\n> Caution\\n>\\n> If you save a provisioned dashboard in the UI and then later update the provisioning source, Grafana always overwrites the database dashboard with the one from the provisioning file.\\n> Grafana ignores the `version` property in the JSON file, even if it’s lower than the dashboard in the database.\\n\\n> Caution\\n>\\n> If you save a provisioned dashboard in the UI and remove the provisioning source, Grafana deletes the dashboard in the database unless you have set the option `disableDeletion` to `true`.\\n\\nIf you set `allowUiUpdates` to `false`, you can’t save changes to a provisioned dashboard.\\nWhen you try to save changes to a provisioned dashboard, Grafana brings up a _Cannot save provisioned dashboard_ dialog box.\\n\\nGrafana offers options to export the JSON definition of a dashboard.\\nTo export the dashboard JSON definition, follow these steps:\\n\\n1. Upon save, click **Advanced options** to expand the section, and then make the following selections:\\n\\n   - **Model**: Choose from **Classic** or **V2 Resource**. Choose **Classic** if you plan to use the dashboard in Grafana v12.4 or older.\\n   - **Format**: For the V2 Resource only, choose from **JSON** or **YAML**\\n2. Click either **Copy JSON to Clipboard** or **Save JSON to file**.\\n\\n\\nThe following screenshot illustrates this behavior.\\n\\n[![](https://grafana.com/static/img/docs/v51/provisioning_cannot_save_dashboard.png?w=1920)](https://grafana.com/static/img/docs/v51/provisioning_cannot_save_dashboard.png)\\n\\nGrafana removes the `id` field from the dashboard JSON to help the provisioning workflow.\\nNow you sync your dashboard changes back to the provisioning source.\\n\\n### Reusable dashboard URLs\\n\\nIf the dashboard in the JSON file contains an [UID](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/build-dashboards/view-dashboard-json-model/), Grafana updates that the dashboard with that UID in the database.\\nThis lets you migrate dashboards between Grafana instances and keep consistent dashboard URLs.\\nWhen Grafana starts, it creates or updates all dashboards available in the configured folders.\\n\\n> Caution\\n>\\n> You can overwrite existing dashboards with provisioning.\\n>\\n> Be careful not to reuse the same `title` multiple times within a folder or `uid` within the same Grafana instance to avoid inconsistent behavior.\\n\\n### Provision folders structure from filesystem to Grafana\\n\\nIf you already store your dashboards using folders in a Git repository or on a filesystem, and want to have the same folder names in the Grafana menu, use `foldersFromFilesStructure` option.\\n\\nFor example, to replicate the following dashboards structure from the filesystem to Grafana:\\n\\n![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\\n\\n```none\\n/etc/dashboards\\n├── /server\\n│   ├── /common_dashboard.json\\n│   └── /network_dashboard.json\\n└── /application\\n    ├── /requests_dashboard.json\\n    └── /resources_dashboard.json\\n```\\n\\nuse the following provisioning configuration file:\\n\\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\\n\\n```yaml\\napiVersion: 1\\n\\nproviders:\\n  - name: dashboards\\n    type: file\\n    updateIntervalSeconds: 30\\n    options:\\n      path: /etc/dashboards\\n      foldersFromFilesStructure: true\\n```\\n\\nGrafana creates the `server` and `application` folders in the UI.\\n\\nTo use `foldersFromFilesStructure`, you must unset the `folder` and `folderUid` options.\\n\\nTo provision dashboards to the root level, store them in the root of your `path`.\\n\\n> Note\\n>\\n> Nested folder structures are supported: the folder hierarchy on disk is recreated in Grafana.\\n>\\n> For example, `folderTwo/folderThree/dashboard3.json` creates a folder `folderTwo` containing a folder `folderThree` that contains the dashboard.\\n>\\n> The folder depth is limited to `4` levels.\\n\\n## Alerting\\n\\nFor information on provisioning Grafana Alerting, refer to [Provision Grafana Alerting resources](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/set-up/provision-alerting-resources/).\\n\\n### Supported settings\\n\\nThe following sections detail the supported settings and secure settings for each alert notification type.\\nIn the provisioning YAML use `settings` for settings and `secure_settings` for secure settings.\\nGrafana encrypts secure settings in the database.\\n\\n#### Alert notification `pushover`\\n\\nExpand table\\n\\n| Name | Secure setting |\\n| --- | --- |\\n| `apiToken` | yes |\\n| `userKey` | yes |\\n| `device` |  |\\n| `priority` |  |\\n| `okPriority` |  |\\n| `retry` |  |\\n| `expire` |  |\\n| `sound` |  |\\n| `okSound` |  |\\n\\n#### Alert notification `discord`\\n\\nExpand table\\n\\n| Name | Secure setting |\\n| --- | --- |\\n| `url` | yes |\\n| `avatar_url` |  |\\n| `content` |  |\\n| `use_discord_username` |  |\\n\\…17709 chars truncated…> Sets the name you use to refer to\n  # the data source in panels and queries.\n  - name: Graphite\n    # <string, required> Sets the data source type.\n    type: graphite\n    # <string, required> Sets the access mode, either\n    # proxy or direct (Server or Browser in the UI).\n    # Some data sources are incompatible with any setting\n    # but proxy (Server).\n    access: proxy\n    # <int> Sets the organization id. Defaults to orgId 1.\n    orgId: 1\n    # <string> Sets a custom UID to reference this\n    # data source in other parts of the configuration.\n    # If not specified, Grafana generates one.\n    uid: my_unique_uid\n    # <string> Sets the data source's URL, including the\n    # port.\n    url: http://localhost:8080\n    # <string> Sets the database user, if necessary.\n    user:\n    # <string> Sets the database name, if necessary.\n    database:\n    # <bool> Enables basic authorization.\n    basicAuth:\n    # <string> Sets the basic authorization username.\n    basicAuthUser:\n    # <bool> Enables credential headers.\n    withCredentials:\n    # <bool> Toggles whether the data source is pre-selected\n    # for new panels. You can set only one default\n    # data source per organization.\n    isDefault:\n    # <map> Fields to convert to JSON and store in jsonData.\n    jsonData:\n      # <string> Defines the Graphite service's version.\n      graphiteVersion: '1.1'\n      # <bool> Enables TLS authentication using a client\n      # certificate configured in secureJsonData.\n      tlsAuth: true\n      # <bool> Enables TLS authentication using a CA\n      # certificate.\n      tlsAuthWithCACert: true\n    # <map> Fields to encrypt before storing in jsonData.\n    secureJsonData:\n      # <string> Defines the CA cert, client cert, and\n      # client key for encrypted authentication.\n      tlsCACert: '...'\n      tlsClientCert: '...'\n      tlsClientKey: '...'\n      # <string> Sets the database password, if necessary.\n      password:\n      # <string> Sets the basic authorization password.\n      basicAuthPassword:\n    # <int> Sets the version. Used to compare versions when\n    # updating. Ignored when creating a new data source.\n    version: 1\n    # <bool> Allows users to edit data sources from the\n    # Grafana UI.\n    editable: false\n```\n\nFor provisioning examples of specific data sources, refer to that [data source’s documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/).\n\n#### JSON data\n\nNot all data sources have the same configuration settings, only the most common ones are fields in the data source provisioning file.\nTo provision the rest of a data source’s settings, include them as JSON in the `jsonData` field.\n\nCommon settings in the [built-in core data sources](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/#built-in-core-data-sources) include:\n\nExpand table\n\n| Name | Type | Data source | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `tlsAuth` | boolean | _HTTP\\*_, MySQL | Enable TLS authentication using client cert configured in secure JSON data |\n| `tlsAuthWithCACert` | boolean | _HTTP\\*_, MySQL, PostgreSQL | Enable TLS authentication using CA cert |\n| `tlsSkipVerify` | boolean | _HTTP\\*_, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL | Controls whether a client verifies the server’s certificate chain and host name. |\n| `serverName` | string | _HTTP\\*_, MSSQL | Optional. Controls the server name used for certificate common name/subject alternative name verification. Defaults to using the data source URL. |\n| `timeout` | string | _HTTP\\*_ | Request timeout in seconds. Overrides `dataproxy.timeout` option |\n| `graphiteVersion` | string | Graphite | Graphite version |\n| `timeInterval` | string | Prometheus, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL and MSSQL | Lowest interval/step value that should be used for this data source. |\n| `httpMode` | string | InfluxDB | HTTP Method. ‘GET’, ‘POST’, defaults to GET |\n| `maxSeries` | number | InfluxDB | Max number of series/tables that Grafana processes |\n| `httpMethod` | string | Prometheus | HTTP Method. ‘GET’, ‘POST’, defaults to POST |\n| `customQueryParameters` | string | Prometheus | Query parameters to add, as a URL-encoded string. |\n| `manageAlerts` | boolean | Prometheus and Loki | Manage alerts via Alerting UI |\n| `alertmanagerUid` | string | Prometheus and Loki | UID of Alertmanager that manages Alert for this data source. |\n| `timeField` | string | Elasticsearch | Which field that should be used as timestamp |\n| `interval` | string | Elasticsearch | Index date time format. nil(No Pattern), ‘Hourly’, ‘Daily’, ‘Weekly’, ‘Monthly’ or ‘Yearly’ |\n| `logMessageField` | string | Elasticsearch | Which field should be used as the log message |\n| `logLevelField` | string | Elasticsearch | Which field should be used to indicate the priority of the log message |\n| `maxConcurrentShardRequests` | number | Elasticsearch | Maximum number of concurrent shard requests that each sub-search request executes per node |\n| `sigV4Auth` | boolean | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | Enable usage of SigV4 |\n| `sigV4AuthType` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | SigV4 auth provider. default/credentials/keys |\n| `sigV4ExternalId` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | Optional SigV4 External ID |\n| `sigV4AssumeRoleArn` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | Optional SigV4 ARN role to assume |\n| `sigV4Region` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | SigV4 AWS region |\n| `sigV4Profile` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | Optional SigV4 credentials profile |\n| `authType` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Auth provider. default/credentials/keys |\n| `externalId` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Optional External ID |\n| `assumeRoleArn` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Optional ARN role to assume |\n| `defaultRegion` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Optional default AWS region |\n| `customMetricsNamespaces` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Namespaces of Custom Metrics |\n| `profile` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Optional credentials profile |\n| `tsdbVersion` | string | OpenTSDB | Version |\n| `tsdbResolution` | string | OpenTSDB | Resolution |\n| `sslmode` | string | PostgreSQL | SSL mode. ‘disable’, ‘require’, ‘verify-ca’ or ‘verify-full’ |\n| `tlsConfigurationMethod` | string | PostgreSQL | SSL certificate configuration, either by ‘file-path’ or ‘file-content’ |\n| `sslRootCertFile` | string | PostgreSQL, MSSQL | SSL server root certificate file, must be readable by the Grafana user |\n| `sslCertFile` | string | PostgreSQL | SSL client certificate file, must be readable by the Grafana user |\n| `sslKeyFile` | string | PostgreSQL | SSL client key file, must be readable by _only_ the Grafana user |\n| `encrypt` | string | MSSQL | Determines SSL encryption handling. Options include: `disable` \\- data sent between client and server is not encrypted; `false` \\- data sent between client and server is not encrypted beyond the login packet; `true` \\- data sent between client and server is encrypted. Default is `false`. |\n| `postgresVersion` | number | PostgreSQL | Postgres version as a number (903/904/905/906/1000) meaning v9.3, v9.4, …, v10 |\n| `timescaledb` | boolean | PostgreSQL | Enable usage of TimescaleDB extension |\n| `maxOpenConns` | number | MySQL, PostgreSQL and MSSQL | Maximum number of open connections to the database (Grafana v5.4+) |\n| `maxIdleConns` | number | MySQL, PostgreSQL and MSSQL | Maximum number of connections in the idle connection pool (Grafana v5.4+) |\n| `connMaxLifetime` | number | MySQL, PostgreSQL and MSSQL | Maximum amount of time in seconds a connection may be reused (Grafana v5.4+) |\n| `keepCookies` | array | _HTTP\\*_ | Cookies that needs to be passed along while communicating with data sources |\n| `prometheusVersion` | string | Prometheus | The version of the Prometheus data source, such as `2.37.0`, `2.24.0` |\n| `prometheusType` | string | Prometheus | Prometheus database type. Options are `Prometheus`, `Cortex`, `Mimir` or`Thanos`. |\n| `cacheLevel` | string | Prometheus | Determines the duration of the browser cache. Valid values include: `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, and `None`. |\n| `incrementalQuerying` | string | Prometheus | Experimental: Turn on incremental querying to enhance dashboard reload performance with slow data sources |\n| `incrementalQueryOverlapWindow` | string | Prometheus | Experimental: Configure incremental query overlap window. Requires a valid duration string, for example, `180s` or `15m` Default value is `10m` (10 minutes). |\n| `disableRecordingRules` | boolean | Prometheus | Experimental: Turn off Prometheus recording rules |\n| `seriesEndpoint` | boolean | Prometheus | Using Prometheus `/api/v1/series` endpoint |\n| `implementation` | string | Alertmanager | The implementation of the Alertmanager data source, such as `prometheus`, `cortex` or `mimir` |\n| `handleGrafanaManagedAlerts` | boolean | Alertmanager | When enabled, Grafana-managed alerts are sent to this Alertmanager |\n\n> Note\n>\n> Data sources tagged with _HTTP\\*_ communicate using the HTTP protocol, which includes all core data source plugins except MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL.\n\nFor examples of specific data sources’ JSON data, refer to that [data source’s documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/).\n\n#### Secure JSON data\n\nSecure JSON data is a map of settings encrypted with a [secret key](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-grafana/#secret_key).\nThe encryption hides the JSON data from the users of Grafana.\nYou should use secure JSON data to store TLS certificates and passwords for data source HTTP requests.\nAll of these settings are optional.\n\nExpand table\n\n| Name | Type | Data source | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `tlsCACert` | string | _HTTP\\*_, MySQL, PostgreSQL | CA cert for out going requests |\n| `tlsClientCert` | string | _HTTP\\*_, MySQL, PostgreSQL | TLS Client cert for outgoing requests |\n| `tlsClientKey` | string | _HTTP\\*_, MySQL, PostgreSQL | TLS Client key for outgoing requests |\n| `password` | string | _HTTP\\*_, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL | password |\n| `basicAuthPassword` | string | _HTTP\\*_ | password for basic authentication |\n| `accessKey` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Access key for connecting to Amazon CloudWatch |\n| `secretKey` | string | Amazon CloudWatch | Secret key for connecting to Amazon CloudWatch |\n| `sigV4AccessKey` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | SigV4 access key. Required when using keys auth provider |\n| `sigV4SecretKey` | string | Elasticsearch and Prometheus | SigV4 secret key. Required when using keys auth provider |\n\n> Note\n>\n> The _HTTP\\*_ tag denotes data sources that communicate using the HTTP protocol, including all core data source plugins except MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL.\n\n#### Custom HTTP headers for data sources\n\nYou can add HTTP headers to all requests sent to data sources managed by Grafana provisioning\nConfigure the header name in the `jsonData` field and the header value in `secureJsonData`.\nThe following example sets the `HeaderName` header to have the value `HeaderValue` and the `Authorization` header to have the value `Bearer XXXXXXXXX`:\n\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\n\n```yaml\napiVersion: 1\n\ndatasources:\n  - name: Graphite\n    jsonData:\n      httpHeaderName1: 'HeaderName'\n      httpHeaderName2: 'Authorization'\n    secureJsonData:\n      httpHeaderValue1: 'HeaderValue'\n      httpHeaderValue2: 'Bearer XXXXXXXXX'\n```\n\n## Plugins\n\nYou can manage plugin applications in Grafana by adding one or more YAML configuration files in the [`provisioning/plugins`](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-grafana/#provisioning) directory.\nEach configuration file contains a list of `apps` that Grafana configures during start up.\nGrafana configures each app to use the configuration in the file.\n\n> Note\n>\n> This feature enables you to provision plugin configurations, not the plugins themselves.\n> You must have already installed the plugin to use plugin configuration provisioning.\n\n### Example plugin configuration file\n\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\n\n```yaml\napiVersion: 1\n\napps:\n  # <string> the type of app, plugin identifier. Required\n  - type: raintank-worldping-app\n    # <int> Org ID. Default to 1, unless org_name is specified\n    org_id: 1\n    # <string> Org name. Overrides org_id unless org_id not specified\n    org_name: Main Org.\n    # <bool> disable the app. Default to false.\n    disabled: false\n    # <map> fields that will be converted to json and stored in jsonData. Custom per app.\n    jsonData:\n      # key/value pairs of string to object\n      key: value\n    # <map> fields that will be converted to json, encrypted and stored in secureJsonData. Custom per app.\n    secureJsonData:\n      # key/value pairs of string to string\n      key: value\n```\n\n## Dashboards\n\nYou can manage dashboards in Grafana by adding one or more YAML configuration files in the [`provisioning/dashboards`](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-grafana/#dashboards) directory.\nEach configuration file contains a list of `providers` that Grafana uses to load dashboards from the local filesystem.\n\n### Example dashboard configuration file\n\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\n\n```yaml\napiVersion: 1\n\nproviders:\n  # <string> an unique provider name. Required\n  - name: 'a unique provider name'\n    # <int> Org id. Default to 1\n    orgId: 1\n    # <string> name of the dashboard folder.\n    folder: ''\n    # <string> folder UID. will be automatically generated if not specified\n    folderUid: ''\n    # <string> provider type. Default to 'file'\n    type: file\n    # <bool> disable dashboard deletion\n    disableDeletion: false\n    # <int> how often Grafana will scan for changed dashboards\n    updateIntervalSeconds: 10\n    # <bool> allow updating provisioned dashboards from the UI\n    allowUiUpdates: false\n    options:\n      # <string, required> path to dashboard files on disk. Required when using the 'file' type\n      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards\n      # <bool> use folder names from filesystem to create folders in Grafana\n      foldersFromFilesStructure: true\n```\n\nWhen Grafana starts, it updates or creates all dashboards found in the configured path.\nThese files can define the dashboard using the dashboard JSON:\n\nJSON![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\n\n```json\n{\n  \"dashboard\": {\n    \"id\": null,\n    \"uid\": \"example-dashboard\",\n    \"title\": \"Production Overview\",\n    \"tags\": [\"production\", \"monitoring\"],\n    \"timezone\": \"browser\",\n    \"schemaVersion\": 16,\n    \"version\": 0,\n    \"refresh\": \"30s\"\n  },\n  \"folderUid\": \"monitoring-folder\",\n  \"overwrite\": true\n}\n```\n\nOr using a Kubernetes format, for example `kubernetes-dashboard.json`:\n\nJSON![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\n\n```json\n{\n  \"kind\": \"Dashboard\",\n  \"apiVersion\": \"dashboard.grafana.app/v1\",\n  \"metadata\": {\n    \"name\": \"dashboard-uid\"\n  },\n  \"spec\": {\n    \"title\": \"Dashboard title\",\n    \"panels\": [\\\n      {\\\n        \"gridPos\": {\\\n          \"h\": 13,\\\n          \"w\": 24,\\\n          \"x\": 0,\\\n          \"y\": 0\\\n        },\\\n        \"options\": {\\\n          \"content\": \"<div><h1>Example panel</h1></div>\",\\\n          \"mode\": \"html\"\\\n        },\\\n        \"transparent\": true,\\\n        \"type\": \"text\"\\\n      }\\\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\nYou _must_ use the Kubernetes resource format to provision dashboards v2 / dynamic dashboards.\n\n> Note\n>\n> Grafana installs dashboards at the root level if you don’t set the `folder` field.\n\n#### Detect updates to provisioned dashboards files\n\nAfter Grafana provisions your dashboards, it checks the filesystem for changes and updates dashboards as needed.\n\nThe mechanism Grafana uses to do this depends on your `updateIntervalSeconds` value:\n\n- **More than 10 seconds**: Grafana polls the path at that interval.\n- **10 seconds or less**: Grafana watches the filesystem for changes and updates dashboards when it detects them.\n\n> Note\n>\n> When `updateIntervalSeconds` is 10 or less, Grafana relies on filesystem watch events to detect changes.\n> Depending on your filesystem and how you mount or sync dashboard files (for example, Docker bind mounts or some network filesystems), those events might not reach Grafana.\n> To work around this, set `updateIntervalSeconds` to more than 10 to force polling, or update your setup so filesystem watch events are propagated.\n\n#### Make changes to a provisioned dashboard\n\nYou can make changes to a provisioned dashboard in the Grafana UI but its not possible to automatically save the changes back to the provisioning source.\nIf `allowUiUpdates` is set to `true` and you make changes to a provisioned dashboard, when you save the dashboard, Grafana persists the changes to its database.\n\n> Caution\n>\n> If you save a provisioned dashboard in the UI and then later update the provisioning source, Grafana always overwrites the database dashboard with the one from the provisioning file.\n> Grafana ignores the `version` property in the JSON file, even if it’s lower than the dashboard in the database.\n\n> Caution\n>\n> If you save a provisioned dashboard in the UI and remove the provisioning source, Grafana deletes the dashboard in the database unless you have set the option `disableDeletion` to `true`.\n\nIf you set `allowUiUpdates` to `false`, you can’t save changes to a provisioned dashboard.\nWhen you try to save changes to a provisioned dashboard, Grafana brings up a _Cannot save provisioned dashboard_ dialog box.\n\nGrafana offers options to export the JSON definition of a dashboard.\nTo export the dashboard JSON definition, follow these steps:\n\n1. Upon save, click **Advanced options** to expand the section, and then make the following selections:\n\n   - **Model**: Choose from **Classic** or **V2 Resource**. Choose **Classic** if you plan to use the dashboard in Grafana v12.4 or older.\n   - **Format**: For the V2 Resource only, choose from **JSON** or **YAML**\n2. Click either **Copy JSON to Clipboard** or **Save JSON to file**.\n\n\nThe following screenshot illustrates this behavior.\n\n[![](https://grafana.com/static/img/docs/v51/provisioning_cannot_save_dashboard.png?w=1920)](https://grafana.com/static/img/docs/v51/provisioning_cannot_save_dashboard.png)\n\nGrafana removes the `id` field from the dashboard JSON to help the provisioning workflow.\nNow you sync your dashboard changes back to the provisioning source.\n\n### Reusable dashboard URLs\n\nIf the dashboard in the JSON file contains an [UID](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/build-dashboards/view-dashboard-json-model/), Grafana updates that the dashboard with that UID in the database.\nThis lets you migrate dashboards between Grafana instances and keep consistent dashboard URLs.\nWhen Grafana starts, it creates or updates all dashboards available in the configured folders.\n\n> Caution\n>\n> You can overwrite existing dashboards with provisioning.\n>\n> Be careful not to reuse the same `title` multiple times within a folder or `uid` within the same Grafana instance to avoid inconsistent behavior.\n\n### Provision folders structure from filesystem to Grafana\n\nIf you already store your dashboards using folders in a Git repository or on a filesystem, and want to have the same folder names in the Grafana menu, use `foldersFromFilesStructure` option.\n\nFor example, to replicate the following dashboards structure from the filesystem to Grafana:\n\n![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\n\n```none\n/etc/dashboards\n├── /server\n│   ├── /common_dashboard.json\n│   └── /network_dashboard.json\n└── /application\n    ├── /requests_dashboard.json\n    └── /resources_dashboard.json\n```\n\nuse the following provisioning configuration file:\n\nYAML![Copy code to clipboard](https://grafana.com/media/images/icons/icon-copy-small-2.svg)Copy\n\n```yaml\napiVersion: 1\n\nproviders:\n  - name: dashboards\n    type: file\n    updateIntervalSeconds: 30\n    options:\n      path: /etc/dashboards\n      foldersFromFilesStructure: true\n```\n\nGrafana creates the `server` and `application` folders in the UI.\n\nTo use `foldersFromFilesStructure`, you must unset the `folder` and `folderUid` options.\n\nTo provision dashboards to the root level, store them in the root of your `path`.\n\n> Note\n>\n> Nested folder structures are supported: the folder hierarchy on disk is recreated in Grafana.\n>\n> For example, `folderTwo/folderThree/dashboard3.json` creates a folder `folderTwo` containing a folder `folderThree` that contains the dashboard.\n>\n> The folder depth is limited to `4` levels.\n\n## Alerting\n\nFor information on provisioning Grafana Alerting, refer to [Provision Grafana Alerting resources](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/set-up/provision-alerting-resources/).\n\n### Supported settings\n\nThe following sections detail the supported settings and secure settings             return name, number
        
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
            futures = [pool.submit(download, part) for part in parts]
            for finished, future in enumerate(as_completed(futures), 1):

                print(f"Downloaded {finished}/{len(parts)}: {name} part {number}", flush=True)

                        while data := source.read(1024 * 1024):

                            output.write(data)
            if temporary.stat().st_size != size or digest.hexdigest() != expected:

            temporary.replace(root / name)

    +
    +在个人目录运行：

    +```
    +
    +安装脚本先核验 Git 忽略规则和未跟踪状态，下载并校验发行包，再解压到固定 `.tools/` 子目录。已有正确校验值的包会复用。两个 SHA256 为：

    +```text
    +920df4d17e78b3b0175af144eb318b0c74d1cf7b1d1251b326966f0e81977260  prometheus-3.15.0.darwin-arm64.tar.gz

    +```
    +
    +启动时分别在三个终端中执行以下命令，保持它们运行；已启动的服务无需重复启动：
    +
    +```sh
    +bash monitoring.sh app
    +bash monitoring.sh prometheus
    +bash monitoring.sh grafana
    +```
    +
    +`monitoring.sh` 根据自身位置设置 `LAB4_ROOT`，显式指定工具、配置、数据库、日志及插件路径。Grafana 启动时把仪表盘副本复制到 `.runtime/grafana/dashboards/`，由 `grafana/provisioning/` 中的配置自动加载数据源和仪表盘。停止时在各自终端按 Ctrl+C，仅停止本项目进程。
    +
    +| 程序 | 本地地址 | 数据位置 |
    +| --- | --- | --- |
    +| 聊天应用 | `http://127.0.0.1:5001/` | `.runtime/app/` |
    +| Prometheus | `http://127.0.0.1:9090/` | `.runtime/prometheus/`，保留 7 天 |
    +| Grafana | `http://127.0.0.1:3000/` | `.runtime/grafana/data/`、`logs/`、`plugins/` |
    +
    +三个服务均只监听 `127.0.0.1`。本项目专用 Grafana 允许本机匿名只读查看，配置通过文件加载，无需输入账号密码。它使用 UID 为 `lab4-prometheus` 的数据源，地址为 `http://127.0.0.1:9090`。导入仪表盘到其他实例时，先使用本项目数据源配置，或把三个 Panel 的数据源改为该实例中的 Prometheus 数据源。
    +
    +Prometheus 的 `chat-app` job 每 2 秒采集 `127.0.0.1:5001/metrics`，采集超时为 1 秒。Target 页面为 `http://127.0.0.1:9090/targets`。应用端口变化时修改 `prometheus.yml`；Prometheus 端口变化时同步修改启动脚本和 Grafana 数据源配置；Grafana 端口变化时同步修改 `grafana.ini` 的 `http_port` 和 `root_url`。
    +
    +仪表盘 UID 为 `lab4-chat-2300017804`，每 2 秒刷新，默认显示最近 15 分钟。三个 Panel 使用：
    +
    +**成功 / 失败请求速率**
    +
    +```promql
    +sum by (outcome) (rate(chat_requests_total{job="chat-app"}[30s]))
    +```
    +
    +按 outcome 分组，显示最近 30 秒内平均每秒完成的请求数，单位为次/秒。
    +
    +**正在处理的请求**
    +
    +```promql
    +sum(chat_inprogress_requests{job="chat-app"})
    +```
    +
    +显示采集时刻正在执行的聊天请求数量。
    +
    +**平均处理耗时**
    +
    +```promql
    +sum(rate(chat_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="chat-app"}[30s]))
    +/
    +sum(rate(chat_request_duration_seconds_count{job="chat-app"}[30s]))
    +```
    +
    +用窗口内耗时总和的增长率除以次数增长率，得到平均服务端耗时，单位秒。Histogram 的 `_bucket{le="3.0"}` 表示耗时不超过 3 秒的累计观测次数；各桶为累积桶，同一次观测可能计入多个上界。没有新请求或采集样本不足时，耗时图可能无值，配置不补零、不制造样本。

    #!/bin/bash
    set -euo pipefail
    LAB4_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
    cd "$LAB4_ROOT"
    
    if [[ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin || "$(uname -m)" != arm64 ]]; then
      printf 'This installer is for macOS ARM64; choose official binaries for your platform.\n' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    
    PROM_ARCHIVE=prometheus-3.15.0.darwin-arm64.tar.gz
    GRAFANA_ARCHIVE=grafana_13.2.4_38252365904_darwin_arm64.tar.gz
    PROM_SHA=920df4d17e78b3b0175af144eb318b0c74d1cf7b1d1251b326966f0e81977260
    GRAFANA_SHA=a910966466359212f1d875748a72a4638c7d3724448d0c369210b31d763b165d
    
    for ignored in \
      ".tools/downloads/$PROM_ARCHIVE" ".tools/downloads/$GRAFANA_ARCHIVE" \
      .tools/downloads/checksums.sha256 .tools/prometheus/prometheus \
      .tools/grafana/bin/grafana .runtime/prometheus/wal \
      .runtime/grafana/data/grafana.db .runtime/grafana/logs/grafana.log \
      .runtime/grafana/plugins/example .venv/pyvenv.cfg; do
      git check-ignore -q -- "$LAB4_ROOT/$ignored" || {
        printf 'Missing ignore rule: %s\n' "$ignored" >&2
        exit 1
      }
    done
    if [[ -n "$(git ls-files -- "$LAB4_ROOT/.tools" "$LAB4_ROOT/.runtime" "$LAB4_ROOT/.venv")" ]]; then
      printf 'Tool/runtime files are already tracked; review them before installing.\n' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    
    mkdir -p .tools/downloads .tools/prometheus .tools/grafana
    download() {
      local archive="$1" expected="$2" url="$3"
      if [[ -f ".tools/downloads/$archive" ]] && \
          [[ "$(shasum -a 256 ".tools/downloads/$archive" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" == "$expected" ]]; then
        printf 'Using verified archive: %s\n' "$archive"
        return
      fi
      curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 \
        --output ".tools/downloads/$archive.part" "$url"
      printf '%s  %s\n' "$expected" "$archive.part" > .tools/downloads/checksums.sha256
      (cd .tools/downloads && shasum -a 256 -c checksums.sha256)
      mv ".tools/downloads/$archive.part" ".tools/downloads/$archive"
    }
    
    download "$PROM_ARCHIVE" "$PROM_SHA" \
      "https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/releases/download/v3.15.0/$PROM_ARCHIVE"
    download "$GRAFANA_ARCHIVE" "$GRAFANA_SHA" \
      "https://dl.grafana.com/grafana/release/13.2.4/$GRAFANA_ARCHIVE"
    
    tar -xzf ".tools/downloads/$PROM_ARCHIVE" -C .tools/prometheus --strip-components=1
    tar -xzf ".tools/downloads/$GRAFANA_ARCHIVE" -C .tools/grafana --strip-components=1
    .tools/prometheus/prometheus --version
    .tools/grafana/bin/grafana --version

    $ cat > download-tools.py <<'PY'
        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
        import hashlib
        from pathlib import Path
        import re
        import subprocess
        
        root = Path(__file__).parent
        jobs = [
            ('prometheus-3.15.0.darwin-arm64.tar.gz', 109656029, '920df4d17e78b3b0175af144eb318b0c74d1cf7b1d1251b326966f0e81977260', 'https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/releases/download/v3.15.0/prometheus-3.15.0.darwin-arm64.tar.gz'),
            ('grafana_13.2.4_38252365904_darwin_arm64.tar.gz', 454523201, 'a910966466359212f1d875748a72a4638c7d3724448d0c369210b31d763b165d', 'https://storage.googleapis.com/grafana-downloads/grafana/release/13.2.4/grafana_13.2.4_38252365904_darwin_arm64.tar.gz'),
        ]
        chunk = 8*1024*1024
        parts = [(name, number, start, min(start+chunk,total)-1, total, url)
                 for name,total,digest,url in jobs for number,start in enumerate(range(0,total,chunk))]
        
        def download(part):
            name,number,start,end,total,url = part
            dest=root/(name+f'.part{number:03d}')
            expected=end-start+1
            for attempt in range(5):
                existing=dest.stat().st_size if dest.exists() else 0
                if existing==expected:
                    return name,number
                if existing>expected:
                    raise RuntimeError(f'Invalid segment size: {name} {number}')
                tail=dest.with_name(dest.name+'.tail')
                headers=dest.with_name(dest.name+'.headers')
                actual_start=start+existing
                source=url+(f'?part={number}&attempt={attempt}' if 'github.com' in url else '')
                result=subprocess.run(['curl','--fail','--location','--silent','--show-error',
                  '--proxy','http://127.0.0.1:7897','--connect-timeout','20','--max-time','120',
                  '--range',f'{actual_start}-{end}','--dump-header',str(headers),
                  '--output',str(tail),source],capture_output=True,text=True)
                header_text=headers.read_text().lower() if headers.exists() else ''
                ranges=re.findall(r'content-range:\s*bytes\s+(\d+)-(\d+)/(\d+)',header_text)
                valid=ranges and tuple(map(int,ranges[-1]))==(actual_start,end,total)
                if valid and tail.exists() and 0<tail.stat().st_size<=expected-existing:
                    with dest.open('ab') as output,tail.open('rb') as incoming:
                        while data:=incoming.read(1024*1024):
                            output.write(data)
                tail.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise RuntimeError(f'Download incomplete: {name} part {number}')
        
        def assemble(job):
            name,total,expected,url=job
            output=root/(name+'.complete')
            digest=hashlib.sha256()
            with output.open('wb') as stream:
                for number,start in enumerate(range(0,total,chunk)):
                    with (root/(name+f'.part{number:03d}')).open('rb') as incoming:
                        while data:=incoming.read(1024*1024):
                            stream.write(data)
                            digest.update(data)
            if output.stat().st_size!=total or digest.hexdigest()!=expected:
                raise RuntimeError(f'SHA256 mismatch: {name}')
            output.replace(root/name)
            print(f'Verified SHA256: {name}',flush=True)
        
        completed={name:set() for name,_,_,_ in jobs}
        verified=set()
        errors=[]
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as pool:
            futures=[pool.submit(download,part) for part in parts]
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                try:
                    name,number=future.result()
                    completed[name].add(number)
                    print(f'Complete {sum(map(len,completed.values()))}/{len(parts)}: {name} part {number}',flush=True)
                    for job in jobs:
                        filename,total,_,_=job
                        if filename not in verified and len(completed[filename])==(total+chunk-1)//chunk:
                            assemble(job)
                            verified.add(filename)
                except Exception as error:
                    errors.append(str(error))
                    print(str(error),flush=True)
        if errors:
            raise SystemExit('\n'.join(errors))
        PY

        import json
        from pathlib import Path
        from urllib.parse import urlencode
        from urllib.request import build_opener, ProxyHandler
        from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
        opener=build_opener(ProxyHandler({}))
        paths=[
        ('app','http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/status'),
        ('targets','http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/targets'),
        ('counter','http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/query?'+urlencode({'query':'chat_requests_total{job="chat-app"}'})),
        ('grafana','http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health'),
        ('datasource','http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/datasources/uid/lab4-prometheus/health'),
        ('dashboard','http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/dashboards/uid/lab4-chat-2300017804'),
        ]
        for name,url in paths:
            try:
                with opener.open(url,timeout=5) as response:
                    data=json.load(response)
                if name=='targets':
                    data=[{k:t[k] for k in ['labels','health','scrapeUrl','lastError','lastScrape']} for t in data['data']['activeTargets']]
                elif name=='dashboard':
                    dashboard=data['dashboard']
                    data={'url':data['meta']['url'],'uid':dashboard['uid'],'panels':[p['title'] for p in dashboard['panels']], 'refresh':dashboard['refresh']}
                print(name,json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False))
            except (HTTPError,URLError) as error:
                print(name,type(error).__name__,str(error))
        PY

    52:### 思考题答不上来时怎样引导
    53-
    54:以下规则适用于所有思考题，以及预测和观察后的讨论。学生说“不知道”“不会”“直接告诉我”，或回答错误、不完整时，**不能因此直接给出完整答案或替学生完成推理**，应通过对话帮助其理解：
    55-
    56-1. 先了解卡在哪里，肯定已有的正确理解；把原题拆成一个更小、具体的问题。
    57-2. 每轮只给一个必要的提示或追问，结合当前代码、指标、图表或简单例子，让学生观察、比较或推测。**提出问题后结束回复，等待学生回应**，不在同一条回复里自问自答。
    58-3. 仍答不上来时，逐步降低难度，补讲缺少的基础概念，再用小问题检验理解。可以解释概念，但不能把本题的完整结论一次性讲完；不要把答案藏在诱导性的问句里，也不要用“标准答案是……你明白了吗？”代替引导。
    59-4. 学生形成理解后，请其用自己的话说明关键原因或结合实际现象解释，再纠正、补充并简短总结。不能只凭“懂了”“继续”就认定已经理解，也不要求背诵固定措辞。

    62-
    63-### 首次讲解：让学生理解为什么做这次实验
    64-
    65-> [AGENT ACTION]
    66-
    67-**这是课程导入，不是术语速览。** 首次回复必须用自然语言讲出下面每段的实质内容，可调整语气，但不能压缩成名词清单、只复述工具名称或直接开始操作。先让零基础学生理解“为什么监控 → 数据从哪里来 → 谁采集、谁展示 → 怎样亲自观察”，再问姓名和学号；不以“我已读完说明”“先准备目录”开头，不先给终端命令或 Git 诊断列表。
    68-
    69-**给学生的开场讲解稿：**
    70-
    71-> 你在前面的实验中已经写出了聊天应用，能打开页面、发送消息。接下来我们关心它运行得怎么样：现在有多少请求？回复有没有变慢？失败是否突然增加？只在某个时刻打开网页，很难看出这些随时间发生的变化。日志能记录一次具体请求发生了什么；这次我们学习用数字概括整体运行情况，再把数字画成图，这就是本实验的监控。
    72->
    73-> **指标（Metric）是什么？** 它是应用记录的一个数值。例如一次聊天处理完成后，把请求总次数加一；开始处理时记下时间，结束后算出用了多少秒。这些数字需要我们在程序里记录，不会因为安装监控软件就自动拥有。应用会提供一个叫 **`/metrics`** 的 HTTP 接口，把当前指标按监控工具能读取的文本格式返回。
    74->
    75-> **Prometheus 做什么？** 它是采集、保存和查询指标的程序。我们告诉它应用地址，它便隔几秒访问一次 `/metrics`，把每次取得的数值和时间一起保存。这种按时间记录的数据叫时间序列。这样才能看到请求量如何变化、回复何时变慢。
    76->
    77-> **Grafana 做什么？** 它是展示数据的工具。我们把 Prometheus 配成它的数据源，再用查询取出想看的数值，画成折线图等图表。一个图表区域叫 **Panel**，多个 Panel 放在一起就是仪表盘。本实验由 Prometheus 保存历史指标，Grafana 把它们展示出来。
    78->
    79-> 为了让图表明显变化，我们会使用课程提前准备的**访问模拟脚本**。它像几个用户一样，通过 HTTP 请求你的聊天接口，分阶段增加访问、模拟慢回复和错误。后端这时使用 **mock 模式**，也就是用测试回复代替真实模型调用；因此不需要 DeepSeek Key，也不产生真实模型调用费用。请求仍经过自己的应用，指标仍在请求处理时产生，脚本不会直接改指标数字。Agent 会先根据你的接口补齐脚本适配部分，你先预测现象，再观察实际图表并解释。
    80->
    81-> 整个实验都在自己的电脑运行。我们按你的操作系统下载可直接启动的 Prometheus 和 Grafana，再启动原聊天应用；这三个程序通过本地地址互相连接。Agent 负责代码、配置和脚本运行，你亲自观察浏览器、提出预测、回答问题并截图。
    82-
    83-讲解后用四个有先后关系的短步骤说明路线和产物：准备应用并记录指标 → 接通采集和仪表盘 → 预测并观察脚本模拟 → 整理截图、项目说明和提交。**首次回复最后只请学生提供姓名、学号**；Agent 自行检查环境，不把 Git 诊断信息当成开场教学。

    120-
    121-准备三个必做指标，推荐名字与用途如下，若学生项目已有合理名称可沿用，但配置和查询必须同步：
    122-
    123-| 类型      | 推荐指标                                            | 实际记录方式                                                                          |
    124-| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
    125-| Counter   | `chat_requests_total{outcome="success"或"error"}` | 聊天请求处理完成后，按结果累计一次。两种 outcome 初始化为 0，方便错误出现前也能查询。 |
    126-| Gauge     | `chat_inprogress_requests`                        | 开始处理时加一，结束时减一；异常路径也必须回落。                                      |
    127-| Histogram | `chat_request_duration_seconds`                   | 记录每次聊天处理的服务端耗时，包含模拟失败；合理设置覆盖 0.1 秒和数秒慢请求的桶。     |
    128-
    129-暴露 `/metrics`，使用 `prometheus_client` 的标准输出格式和内容类型。业务指标只统计聊天处理，不把 Prometheus 周期访问 `/metrics`、状态接口、静态资源访问计入聊天数量。不要把消息内容、姓名、请求 ID 等作为标签。
    130-

    132-
    133-1. 后端启动配置明确区分 mock 与 real。在 mock 模式中不创建/调用真实模型客户端，不因缺少 Key 启动失败。
    134-2. 增加只在实验模式可用的非敏感状态接口，让脚本能核验当前服务为 mock 且外部模型调用关闭。推荐返回 `{"mode":"mock","external_model_calls":false}`；内容必须反映实际配置，不是固定谎报。real 模式不得通过同一接口报告 mock。
    135-3. 原聊天请求在 mock 模式下可带有实验用的延迟与失败选项。后端限制延迟范围、处理固定测试回复/明确模拟错误；这些选项不得改变 real 模式的真实调用行为。

    # Lab 4：陈川泽 2300017804
    
    基于本人 Lab 3 的 Flask 聊天应用，保留原 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 页面、多轮会话和消息增删改查。Lab 4 在本地使用 mock 回复，通过真实 HTTP 请求记录聊天指标。
    
    ## 应用运行
    
    环境为 macOS / Apple Silicon，终端为 zsh。以下命令在本个人目录执行：
    
    ```sh
    python3.13 -m venv .venv
    .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    CHAT_MODE=mock .venv/bin/python -B app.py
    ```
    
    应用以单进程、多线程方式监听 `127.0.0.1:5001`，关闭 debug 和自动重载。需要更换端口时可设置 `PORT`，并同步修改个人 `prometheus.yml` 的 target。前台运行时按 Ctrl+C 停止。
    
    - 页面：`http://127.0.0.1:5001/`
    - 模拟状态：`http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/status`
    - 指标：`http://127.0.0.1:5001/metrics`
    
    默认 `CHAT_MODE=mock`，无需 Key，不导入或创建真实模型客户端，也不读取 `.env`。`/api/status` 根据启动配置返回 `{"mode":"mock","external_model_calls":false}`。原真实模型调用保留在 `real` 分支，只从运行环境读取 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`；本实验不启用该分支。real 模式的实验状态接口返回 404，模拟参数不会改变真实调用行为。
    
    本次聊天数据保存在 `.runtime/app/mock-conversations.json`，与原 Lab 2/3 数据隔离；real 模式使用独立文件。存储使用锁保护 ID 分配、读写和 JSON 序列化，文件先写临时文件再替换。生成回复期间不持有全局存储锁；同一会话的并发请求各自使用开始时的历史快照，按完成顺序追加完整问答。回复期间会话被删除时返回 409。
    
    ## 聊天请求与模拟参数
    
    原有两个聊天入口均保留：
    
    - `POST /api/messages`：单消息聊天。
    - `POST /api/conversations/<id>/messages`：页面使用的多轮会话聊天。
    
    请求正文中的 `message` 是非空字符串。mock 模式还接受：
    
    | 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `mock_delay` | `0.1` | 服务端处理期间等待的秒数，接受 0～10 的有限数字。 |
    | `mock_error` | `false` | 为 `true` 时，在等待后返回 HTTP 503 和 `code: mock_error`。 |
    
    成功响应为 HTTP 201，包含 `id`、`message`、`reply`；固定回复说明当前是本地 mock。参数无效返回 400。模拟失败不写入聊天记录。
    
    ## 指标
    
    指标定义位于 `metrics.py`，`/metrics` 使用 `prometheus_client` 的标准文本输出及内容类型。
    
    | 指标 | 类型 | 含义 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `chat_requests_total{outcome="success"或"error"}` | Counter | 聊天处理结束后的累计次数，按最终结果区分。 |
    | `chat_inprogress_requests` | Gauge | 正在处理的聊天请求数量。 |
    | `chat_request_duration_seconds` | Histogram | 从进入聊天处理到形成响应的服务端耗时，单位秒。 |
    
    两个聊天 POST 入口统计正常回复、模拟失败、参数错误和意外异常；请求结束时完成指标收尾。会话管理、消息编辑/删除、静态资源、状态检查及指标采集本身不计入聊天指标。标签仅包含固定结果值，不包含消息内容或用户标识。
    
    耗时桶上界为 `0.05、0.1、0.25、0.5、1、2、3、5、10、30、60、+Inf` 秒，同时输出耗时总和 `_sum` 和观测次数 `_count`。进程重启后内存指标重新开始累计。页面发出的聊天请求、Agent 的聊天接口验证都会产生真实计数。

    ## 文件与运行目录
    
    `simulate_traffic.py` 是课程访问调度器的个人副本，只发送 HTTP 请求；项目接口适配集中在 `project_adapter.py`，采集配置为 `prometheus.yml`。
    
    工具下载包放在 `.tools/downloads/`，Prometheus 和 Grafana 分别解压到 `.tools/prometheus/`、`.tools/grafana/`。对应运行数据放在 `.runtime/prometheus/` 和 `.runtime/grafana/`，应用运行数据及日志放在 `.runtime/app/`，Python 环境放在 `.venv/`。这些目录及 `.env` 已被个人 `.gitignore` 排除；配置、仪表盘、`results/*.json` 和截图可正常提交。
    
    参考：[Prometheus Python 指标类型](https://prometheus.github.io/client_python/instrumenting/)、[Histogram](https://prometheus.github.io/client_python/instrumenting/histogram/)。

    Prometheus 的 `chat-app` job 每 2 秒采集 `127.0.0.1:5001/metrics`，采集超时为 1 秒。Target 页面为 `http://127.0.0.1:9090/targets`。应用端口变化时修改 `prometheus.yml`；Prometheus 端口变化时同步修改启动脚本和 Grafana 数据源配置；Grafana 端口变化时同步修改 `grafana.ini` 的 `http_port` 和 `root_url`。
    
    仪表盘 UID 为 `lab4-chat-2300017804`，每 2 秒刷新，默认显示最近 15 分钟。三个 Panel 使用：
    
    **成功 / 失败请求速率**
    
    ```promql
    sum by (outcome) (rate(chat_requests_total{job="chat-app"}[30s]))
    ```
    
    按 outcome 分组，显示最近 30 秒内平均每秒完成的请求数，单位为次/秒。
    
    **正在处理的请求**
    
    ```promql
    sum(chat_inprogress_requests{job="chat-app"})
    ```
    
    显示采集时刻正在执行的聊天请求数量。
    
    **平均处理耗时**
    
    ```promql
    sum(rate(chat_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="chat-app"}[30s]))
    /
    sum(rate(chat_request_duration_seconds_count{job="chat-app"}[30s]))
    ```
    
    用窗口内耗时总和的增长率除以次数增长率，得到平均服务端耗时，单位秒。Histogram 的 `_bucket{le="3.0"}` 表示耗时不超过 3 秒的累计观测次数；各桶为累积桶，同一次观测可能计入多个上界。没有新请求或采集样本不足时，耗时图可能无值，配置不补零、不制造样本。

    """本地监控实验访问调度器（Python 3.9+，仅使用标准库）。
    
    先由 Agent 补齐同目录 project_adapter.py，再运行本文件。
    它只通过 HTTP 访问应用，不直接读写 Prometheus 指标。
    """
    
    import argparse
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    import ipaddress
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import threading
    import time
    from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    from urllib.request import HTTPRedirectHandler, ProxyHandler, build_opener
    
    import project_adapter
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class Phase:
        name: str
        rate: float
        delay: float
        error_every: int = 0
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class Observation:
        success: bool
        transport_error: bool
        expected_error: bool
        seconds: float
    
    
    class NoRedirect(HTTPRedirectHandler):
        def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
            return None
    
    
    def timestamp():
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    
    
    def local_origin(url):
        """只允许访问本机；也用于检查适配器构造的请求是否偏离目标。"""
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parts.hostname:
            raise ValueError("目标必须为本地 http/https 地址")
        if parts.username or parts.password or parts.query or parts.fragment:
            raise ValueError("地址不得包含凭据、查询参数或片段")
        host = parts.hostname.lower()
        if host != "localhost":
            try:
                is_local = ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_loopback
            except ValueError:
                is_local = False
            if not is_local:
                raise ValueError("本实验仅访问 localhost、127.0.0.1 或 ::1")
        return parts.scheme, host, parts.port or (443 if parts.scheme == "https" else 80)
    
    
    def send_one(base_url, phase, number, timeout, stop):
        if stop.is_set():
            return None
        expected_error = bool(phase.error_every and number % phase.error_every == 0)
        request = project_adapter.build_chat_request(
            base_url, "监控实验测试消息", phase.delay, expected_error
        )
        if local_origin(request.full_url) != local_origin(base_url):
            raise ValueError("适配器请求必须与 --base-url 使用同一主机和端口")
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            # 每个线程独立 opener；禁止重定向至其他服务。
            opener = build_opener(ProxyHandler({}), NoRedirect())
            try:
                with opener.open(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
                    code = response.status
                    body = response.read(1024 * 1024)
            except HTTPError as error:
                with error:
                    code = error.code
                    body = error.read(1024 * 1024)
            success = project_adapter.response_is_success(code, body)
            if not isinstance(success, bool):
                raise TypeError("response_is_success 必须返回 bool")
            return Observation(success, False, expected_error, time.monotonic() - started)
        except (URLError, TimeoutError, OSError):
            return Observation(False, True, expected_error, time.monotonic() - started)
    
    
    def run_phase(base_url, phase, duration, concurrency, timeout, stop):
        """固定发送间隔、有限并发，不堆积无界请求队列。阶段结束等待在途请求。"""
        start_time = timestamp()
        started = time.monotonic()
        pending, observations = set(), []
        scheduled = skipped = 0
    
        def collect_done():
            for future in list(pending):
                if future.done():
                    pending.remove(future)
                    result = future.result()
                    if result is not None:
                        observations.append(result)
    
        print(f"[{start_time}] {phase.name}: {duration:g}s, "
              f"目标 {phase.rate:g} 次/秒, 后端延迟 {phase.delay:g}s", flush=True)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as pool:
            try:
                next_send = started
                while not stop.is_set() and time.monotonic() < started + duration:
                    collect_done()
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if now < next_send:
                        stop.wait(min(next_send - now, 0.05))
                        continue
                    scheduled += 1
                    if len(pending) < concurrency:
                        pending.add(pool.submit(send_one, base_url, phase, scheduled, timeout, stop))
                    else:
                        skipped += 1
                    # 调度落后时不突发补发；实际发送量写入结果。
                    next_send = max(next_send + 1 / phase.rate, now)
                for future in pending:
                    result = future.result()
                    if result is not None:
                        observations.append(result)
            except BaseException:
                stop.set()
                for future in pending:
                    future.cancel()
                raise
    
        durations = [item.seconds for item in observations]
        report = {
            "phase": phase.name, "started_at": start_time, "ended_at": timestamp(),
            "settings": asdict(phase), "duration_seconds": duration,
            "scheduled": scheduled, "sent": len(observations), "skipped": skipped,
            "success": sum(item.success for item in observations),
            "http_or_business_errors": sum(not item.success and not item.transport_error
                                           for item in observations),
            "transport_errors": sum(item.transport_error for item in observations),
            "unexpected_results": sum(not item.transport_error and
                                      item.success == item.expected_error
                                      for item in observations),
            # 客户端耗时含网络开销，不等同于服务端 Histogram。
            "client_mean_seconds": sum(durations) / len(durations) if durations else None,
        }
        print(f"[{report['ended_at']}] {phase.name} 完成: 发送 {report['sent']}, "
              f"成功 {report['success']}, 业务/HTTP错误 {report['http_or_business_errors']}, "
              f"网络错误 {report['transport_errors']}, 非预期结果 {report['unexpected_results']}, "
              f"跳过 {skipped}", flush=True)
        return report
    
    
    def arguments(argv=None):
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("--base-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:5001")
        parser.add_argument("--scenario", choices=["all", "baseline", "burst", "slow", "errors", "recovery"], default="all")
        parser.add_argument("--phase-seconds", type=float, default=30)
        parser.add_argument("--baseline-rate", type=float, default=1)
        parser.add_argument("--burst-rate", type=float, default=4)
        parser.add_argument("--slow-rate", type=float, default=2)
        parser.add_argument("--slow-delay", type=float, default=3)
        parser.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=6)
        parser.add_argument("--error-every", type=int, default=3)
        parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10)
        parser.add_argument("--settle-seconds", type=float, default=10)
        parser.add_argument("--output", default="simulation_results.json")
        args = parser.parse_args(argv)
        try:
            local_origin(args.base_url)
            if urlsplit(args.base_url).path not in ("", "/"):
                raise ValueError("--base-url 只写服务根地址，接口路径由适配器填写")
            for name in ("phase_seconds", "baseline_rate", "burst_rate", "slow_rate", "timeout"):
                value = getattr(args, name)
                if not 0 < value <= (300 if name == "phase_seconds" else 30):
                    raise ValueError(f"{name} 超出教学实验范围")
            if not 1 <= args.concurrency <= 20 or args.error_every < 2:
                raise ValueError("并发数应为 1～20，error-every 至少为 2")
            if not 0.1 < args.timeout or not 0 <= args.slow_delay < args.timeout or not 0 <= args.settle_seconds <= 60:
                raise ValueError("请求超时应大于 0.1 秒及模拟延迟；收尾等待为 0～60 秒")
        except ValueError as error:
            parser.error(str(error))
        return args

            Phase("baseline", args.baseline_rate, 0.1),
            Phase("burst", args.burst_rate, 0.1),
            Phase("slow", args.slow_rate, args.slow_delay),
            Phase("errors", args.baseline_rate, 0.1, args.error_every),
            Phase("recovery", args.baseline_rate, 0.1),
        ]
        reports = []
        interrupted = False
        try:
            if project_adapter.confirm_mock_mode(args.base_url.rstrip("/"), args.timeout) is not True:
                raise ValueError("服务未确认处于 mock 模式，未发送聊天请求")
            print("已核验服务模拟模式；脚本通过实际 HTTP 接口产生监测数据。", flush=True)
            for phase in phases:
                if args.scenario in ("all", phase.name):
                    reports.append(run_phase(args.base_url.rstrip("/"), phase, args.phase_seconds,
                                             args.concurrency, args.timeout, stop))
            print(f"请求已结束，等待 {args.settle_seconds:g}s 让采集器记录恢复状态。", flush=True)
            stop.wait(args.settle_seconds)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            stop.set()
            interrupted = True
            print("已中断，停止发出新请求；结果只保留已完成的阶段。", flush=True)
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"运行失败（{type(error).__name__}）：请检查适配器、模拟模式及本地服务。")
            return 2
        output = Path(args.output)
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output.write_text(json.dumps({"base_url": args.base_url, "interrupted": interrupted,
                                     "phases": reports}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                          encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"阶段时间与结果已写入 {output}；请与 Grafana 曲线对照。", flush=True)
        if interrupted:
            return 130
        return int(any(item["transport_errors"] or item["unexpected_results"] for item in reports))
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        raise SystemExit(main())

    import json
    import os
    from functools import wraps
    from pathlib import Path
    from threading import RLock
    from time import sleep
    
    from flask import Flask, Response, jsonify, request, send_from_directory
    from prometheus_client import CONTENT_TYPE_LATEST, generate_latest
    
    from metrics import REGISTRY, track_chat
    
    
    app = Flask(__name__, static_folder="frontend", static_url_path="/frontend")
    app.json.ensure_ascii = False
    app.config["CHAT_MODE"] = os.getenv("CHAT_MODE", "mock").lower()
    if app.config["CHAT_MODE"] not in ("mock", "real"):
        raise ValueError("CHAT_MODE 必须为 mock 或 real")
    runtime_dir = Path(__file__).parent / ".runtime" / "app"
    data_file = Path(os.getenv(
        "APP_DATA_FILE", str(runtime_dir / f"{app.config['CHAT_MODE']}-conversations.json")
    ))
    state_lock = RLock()
    MAX_MOCK_DELAY = 10.0
    
    
    def with_state_lock(view):
        """Serialize short CRUD operations, including response serialization."""
        @wraps(view)
        def wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
            with state_lock:
                return app.make_response(view(*args, **kwargs))
        return wrapped
    
    
    def load_state():
        if not data_file.exists():
            return [], []
        contents = data_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if not contents.strip():
            return [], []
    
        state = json.loads(contents)
        if not isinstance(state, dict):
            raise ValueError("聊天数据文件的最外层必须是 JSON 对象")
        stored_messages = state.get("messages", [])
        stored_conversations = state.get("conversations", [])
        if not isinstance(stored_messages, list) or not isinstance(stored_conversations, list):
            raise ValueError("聊天数据文件中的 messages 和 conversations 必须是数组")
        return stored_messages, stored_conversations
    
    
    def save_state():
        data_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        state = {"messages": messages, "conversations": conversations}
        temporary_file = data_file.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temporary_file.write_text(
            json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        temporary_file.replace(data_file)
    
    
    messages, conversations = load_state()
    next_message_id = max((item["id"] for item in messages), default=0) + 1
    next_conversation_id = max((item["id"] for item in conversations), default=0) + 1
    next_turn_id = max(
        (message["turn_id"] for conversation in conversations for message in conversation["messages"]),
        default=0,
    ) + 1
    
    
    def generate_reply(chat_messages, options=None):
        if app.config["CHAT_MODE"] == "mock":
            options = options or {}
            delay = options.get("mock_delay", 0.1)
            force_error = options.get("mock_error", False)
            if type(delay) not in (int, float) or not 0 <= delay <= MAX_MOCK_DELAY:
                return None, ({"error": "mock_delay 必须是 0～10 秒之间的有限数字"}, 400)
            if not isinstance(force_error, bool):
                return None, ({"error": "mock_error 必须是布尔值"}, 400)
            sleep(delay)
            if force_error:
                return None, ({"error": "模拟模型请求失败", "code": "mock_error"}, 503)
            return "这是本地 mock 回复：应用已收到测试消息。", None
    
        # Real mode is retained for the original app; this lab never enables it.
        api_key = os.getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
        if not api_key:
            return None, ({"error": "服务器尚未配置 DeepSeek API Key"}, 503)
    
        try:
            from openai import OpenAI
    
            client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url="https://api.deepseek.com", timeout=45.0)
            completion = client.chat.completions.create(
                model="deepseek-flash",
                messages=chat_messages,
                stream=False,
                extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}},
            )
            reply = completion.choices[0].message.content
            if not reply:
                return None, ({"error": "DeepSeek 未返回回复内容"}, 502)
            return reply, None
        except Exception:
            return None, ({"error": "DeepSeek 请求失败，请稍后重试或检查服务配置"}, 502)
    
    
    def find_conversation(conversation_id):
        return next((item for item in conversations if item["id"] == conversation_id), None)
    
    
    @app.get("/")
    def index():
        return send_from_directory(app.static_folder, "index.html")
    
    
    @app.get("/api/hello")
    def hello():
        return {"message": "你好"}
    
    
    @app.get("/api/status")
    def status():
        if app.config["CHAT_MODE"] != "mock":
            return {"error": "实验状态接口仅在 mock 模式下可用"}, 404
        return {"mode": app.config["CHAT_MODE"], "external_model_calls": False}
    
    
    @app.get("/metrics")
    def expose_metrics():
        return Response(generate_latest(REGISTRY), content_type=CONTENT_TYPE_LATEST)
    
    
    @app.post("/api/messages")
    @track_chat
    def create_message():
        global next_message_id
    
        data = request.get_json(silent=True)
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("message"), str):
            return {"error": "请提供 JSON 格式的 message 字符串"}, 400
    
        message = data["message"].strip()
        if not message:
            return {"error": "消息不能为空"}, 400
    
        reply, error = generate_reply([{"role": "user", "content": message}], data)
        if error:
            return error
    
        with state_lock:
            record = {"id": next_message_id, "message": message, "reply": reply}
            next_message_id += 1
            messages.append(record)
            save_state()
            return jsonify(record), 201
    
    
    @app.get("/api/messages")
    @with_state_lock
    def list_messages():
        return jsonify(messages)
    
    
    @app.patch("/api/messages/<int:message_id>")
    @with_state_lock
    def update_message(message_id):
        record = next((item for item in messages if item["id"] == message_id), None)
        if record is None:
            return {"error": "聊天记录不存在"}, 404
    
        data = request.get_json(silent=True)
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("message"), str):
            return {"error": "请提供 JSON 格式的 message 字符串"}, 400
    
        message = data["message"].strip()
        if not message:
            return {"error": "消息不能为空"}, 400
    
        record["message"] = message
        save_state()
        return record
    
    
    @app.delete("/api/messages/<int:message_id>")
    @with_state_lock
    def delete_message(message_id):
        record = next((item for item in messages if item["id"] == message_id), None)
        if record is None:
            return {"error": "聊天记录不存在"}, 404
    
        messages.remove(record)
        save_state()
        return {"message": "已删除"}
    
    
    @app.post("/api/conversations")
    @with_state_lock
    def create_conversation():
        global next_conversation_id
    
        data = request.get_json(silent=True)
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            return {"error": "请提供 JSON 格式的会话标题"}, 400
        title = data.get("title", "新会话")
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip():
            return {"error": "会话标题不能为空"}, 400
    
        conversation = {"id": next_conversation_id, "title": title.strip(), "messages": []}
        next_conversation_id += 1
        conversations.append(conversation)
        save_state()
        return conversation, 201
    
    
    @app.get("/api/conversations")
    @with_state_lock
    def list_conversations():
        return jsonify([
            {"id": item["id"], "title": item["title"], "message_count": len(item["messages"]) // 2}
            for item in conversations
        ])
    
    
    @app.get("/api/conversations/<int:conversation_id>")
    @with_state_lock
    def get_conversation(conversation_id):
        conversation = find_conversation(conversation_id)
        if conversation is None:
            return {"error": "会话不存在"}, 404
        return conversation
    
    
    @app.patch("/api/conversations/<int:conversation_id>")
    @with_state_lock
    def rename_conversation(conversation_id):
        conversation = find_conversation(conversation_id)
        if conversation is None:
            return {"error": "会话不存在"}, 404
    
        data = request.get_json(silent=True)
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("title"), str):
            return {"error": "请提供 JSON 格式的 title 字符串"}, 400
        title = data["title"].strip()
        if not title:
            return {"error": "会话标题不能为空"}, 400
    
        conversation["title"] = title
        save_state()
        return conversation
    
    
    @app.delete("/api/conversations/<int:conversation_id>")
    @with_state_lock
    def delete_conversation(conversation_id):
        conversation = find_conversation(conversation_id)
        if conversation is None:
            return {"error": "会话不存在"}, 404
        conversations.remove(conversation)
        save_state()
        return {"message": "会话已删除"}
    
    
    @app.post("/api/conversations/<int:conversation_id>/messages")
    @track_chat
    def create_conversation_message(conversation_id):
        global next_turn_id
    
        data = request.get_json(silent=True)
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("message"), str):
            return {"error": "请提供 JSON 格式的 message 字符串"}, 400
        message = data["message"].strip()
        if not message:
            return {"error": "消息不能为空"}, 400
    
        with state_lock:
            conversation = find_conversation(conversation_id)
            if conversation is None:
                return {"error": "会话不存在"}, 404
            history = [
                {"role": item["role"], "content": item["content"]}
                for item in conversation["messages"]
            ]
        # Neither the model call nor the mock delay holds the shared storage lock.
        reply, error = generate_reply(history + [{"role": "user", "content": message}], data)
        if error:
            return error
    
        with state_lock:
            if find_conversation(conversation_id) is not conversation:
                return {"error": "回复生成期间会话已被删除"}, 409
            turn_id = next_turn_id
            next_turn_id += 1
            conversation["messages"].extend([
                {"turn_id": turn_id, "role": "user", "content": message},
                {"turn_id": turn_id, "role": "assistant", "content": reply},
            ])
            save_state()
            return {"id": turn_id, "message": message, "reply": reply}, 201
    
    
    @app.patch("/api/conversations/<int:conversation_id>/messages/<int:turn_id>")
    @with_state_lock
    def update_conversation_message(conversation_id, turn_id):
        conversation = find_conversation(conversation_id)
        if conversation is None:
            return {"error": "会话不存在"}, 404
        user_message = next((item for item in conversation["messages"] if item["turn_id"] == turn_id and item["role"] == "user"), None)
        if user_message is None:
            return {"error": "聊天记录不存在"}, 404
    
        data = request.get_json(silent=True)
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("message"), str):
            return {"error": "请提供 JSON 格式的 message 字符串"}, 400
        message = data["message"].strip()
        if not message:
            return {"error": "消息不能为空"}, 400
    
        user_message["content"] = message
        save_state()
        return {"id": turn_id, "message": message}
    
    
    @app.delete("/api/conversations/<int:conversation_id>/messages/<int:turn_id>")
    @with_state_lock
    def delete_conversation_message(conversation_id, turn_id):
        conversation = find_conversation(conversation_id)
        if conversation is None:
            return {"error": "会话不存在"}, 404
        if not any(item["turn_id"] == turn_id for item in conversation["messages"]):
            return {"error": "聊天记录不存在"}, 404
    
        conversation["messages"] = [
            item for item in conversation["messages"] if item["turn_id"] != turn_id
        ]
        save_state()
        return {"message": "已删除"}
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        app.run(
            host="127.0.0.1", port=int(os.getenv("PORT", "5001")),
            debug=False, threaded=True, use_reloader=False,
        )

        from threading import Thread
        from urllib.error import HTTPError

        import project_adapter as adapter
        
        assert adapter.ADAPTER_READY is False
        base = 'http://127.0.0.1:5001'
        opener = build_opener(ProxyHandler({}), adapter.NoRedirect())
        
        def request(req):
            try:
                with opener.open(req, timeout=3) as res:
                    return res.status, res.read()
            except HTTPError as error:
                with error:
                    return error.code, error.read()
        
        def metrics():
            code, body = request(base + '/metrics')
            assert code == 200
            values = {}
            for line in body.decode().splitlines():
                if line and not line.startswith('#'):
                    name, value = line.split()[:2]
                    values[name] = float(value)
            return values
        
        assert adapter.confirm_mock_mode(base, 3)
        before = metrics()
        code, good_body = request(adapter.build_chat_request(base, '适配器单请求验证', 0.1, False))

        record_id = json.loads(good_body)['id']
        code, bad_body = request(adapter.build_chat_request(base, '适配器模拟失败验证', 0.1, True))
        assert code == 503 and json.loads(bad_body)['code'] == 'mock_error'
        assert adapter.response_is_success(code, bad_body) is False
        after = metrics()
        for name in ('chat_requests_total{outcome="success"}', 'chat_requests_total{outcome="error"}'):
            assert after[name] - before[name] == 1
        assert after['chat_request_duration_seconds_count'] - before['chat_request_duration_seconds_count'] == 2
        assert after['chat_inprogress_requests'] == 0
        assert request(Request(f'{base}/api/messages/{record_id}', method='DELETE'))[0] == 200

            assert adapter.response_is_success(status, body) is False
        print('Response validation: invalid JSON, wrong status, incomplete reply and error payloads rejected')

        from contextlib import redirect_stderr, redirect_stdout
        from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
        from io import StringIO
        from pathlib import Path
        from threading import Thread
        from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
        import simulate_traffic
        import project_adapter
        
        class NonMockService(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            calls = []
            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass
            def do_GET(self):
                self.calls.append(('GET', self.path))
                raw = b'{"mode":"real","external_model_calls":true}'
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(raw)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(raw)
            def do_POST(self):
                self.calls.append(('POST', self.path))
                self.send_response(500)
                self.end_headers()
        
        assert project_adapter.ADAPTER_READY is True
        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), NonMockService)
        thread = Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            with TemporaryDirectory(dir='.runtime/app') as temporary:
                output = Path(temporary) / 'must-not-exist.json'
                with redirect_stdout(StringIO()):
                    code = simulate_traffic.main(['--base-url', f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}', '--output', str(output)])
                assert code == 2 and not output.exists()
            assert NonMockService.calls == [('GET', '/api/status')], NonMockService.calls
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join()
        with redirect_stderr(StringIO()):
            try:
                simulate_traffic.arguments(['--base-url', 'https://example.com'])
            except SystemExit as error:
                assert error.code == 2
            else:
                raise AssertionError('Non-local URL was accepted')
        assert Path('simulate_traffic.py').read_bytes() == Path('../starter/simulate_traffic.py').read_bytes()
        print('Scheduler rejects non-mock service before any chat request or output file; non-local URL rejected')
